hook: Save gold to grow the Hive, then blow it all in one huge Carnival turn.
loop: Choose each gold: spend it for Fanfare, or hold it for Reserve.
A held float pays Reserve every turn while you spend income.
Drain the float in one big turn to fire every Fanfare.

growth.line: Small permanent +1/+1s each turn across a town, spiking on the drain turn when Cigale pays per gold.

feel.early: Lean: bank a float; Comb Guard holds early fights.
feel.mid: Fanfares wake up; reading order and last gold matter.
feel.late: The float pays every turn, or one huge drain turn.

stars.why: Every gold past income buffs the band: the drain-turn payoff.
Pays for keeping Spent and Purse level; both towns in one build.
Free gold if you end broke, a tax if you save.

card_short.u01: Hive. Gains up to +3 Attack in fights from Purse.
card_short.u02: Road. Grows Health on Reserve 3, Attack on Fanfare 6.
card_short.u03: Hive. End of Turn: spends 1 gold to buff neighbours.
card_short.u05: Carnival. Fanfare 7: buffs three random other units.
card_short.u06: Hive. Reserve 5: interest gold next turn, more at 10.
card_short.u07: Carnival. Gains stats in fights per 2 gold spent.
card_short.u08: Hive. Reserve 6: buffs the units next to it.
card_short.u09: Road. Lowers neighbours' Fanfare and Reserve numbers by 2.
card_short.u10: Carnival. Gains 2 gold each turn; takes up to 3 back.
card_short.u11: Carnival. Fanfares fire again at double their number.
card_short.u12: Hive. Front row gains Health in fights from Purse gold.
card_short.u13: Road. Fanfare 8 buffs Hive; Reserve 8 buffs Carnival.
card_short.u14: Hive. Reserve: buffs Hive units per 4 Purse gold.
card_short.u15: Hive. Start of Combat: 3 damage per 2 Purse gold.
card_short.u16: Carnival. End of Turn: buffs Carnival units per 4 spent.
card_short.u17: Hive. Your Reserve effects trigger twice.
card_short.u18: Carnival. Each gold spent past income buffs every Carnival unit.
card_short.u19: Road. Buffs all units by half your smaller counter.
card_short.x01: Rule: income is base gold; Cigale counts gold beyond it.
card_short.x02: Sealer's gold counts as Spent, can tip Horn or Tettix.
card_short.x03: Units before the Borrower count the Purse before he takes.
card_short.x04: Lantern's refund helps reach Tithonus's second Fanfare.
card_short.x05: Tier up counts as Spent: your biggest Fanfare turn.
card_short.x06: Last gold: roll to cross Fanfare, or keep for Reserve.
card_short.x07: Selling grown units gives extra gold Cigale counts.

builds.name: The Festival (Carnival)
builds.line: End every turn broke; Borrower, Lantern and Tithonus keep the band growing.

builds.name: Saint's Day (crossing)
builds.line: Save two or three turns, then drain it all in one turn.

builds.name: Balanced Books (Ottavia)
builds.line: Keep Spent equal to Purse; Ottavia and Afide feed both towns.

liked: Every last gold is a choice: roll to cross a Fanfare or save it.
The save-then-drain turn is a real payoff; Ottavia's balanced books stood out.
worries: Watch: Melissa, Gravelle, Ottavia run hot late; Cigale's drain turn is huge.
Fights are mostly +1/+1 piles; a banked float stops asking for decisions.
changed: Every unit now prints its town; Road units count as both.
Comb Guard is now a 2/3, to win early fights.
Fennimore, Tithonus and Cigale now say exactly which numbers and gold count.
verdict: Rated 6.7 fun and 7.0 distinct, third of its seed's three; for players who enjoy gold sums and timing.
